text: I want to go on a trip with my family over spring, March 19-29. Preferably a nice retreat. I want to feel good because life has been stressful recently. Outdoors stuff.

assumptions: You want to come back rested, so rest and ease count for more than challenge.
Read “retreat” as somewhere restful with comfortable places to stay, not only a spa.
Read “outdoors” as easy time in nature unless you ask for something harder.

readout.spread: Three different answers — Jamaica for food and villages and culture; Tongariro & Rotorua for hot springs and day hiking; Palawan: El Nido & Coron for coastal scenery and beaches and swimming.

picks.name: Jamaica
picks.why: Beaches and swimming and easy for a family; one base in Port Antonio or Treasure Beach, easier with a car.
tradeoffs: All-inclusive enclaves can feel cut off from the island
Slow, winding roads
Persistent touts in tourist areas

picks.name: Tongariro & Rotorua
picks.why: Hot springs, easy for a family and day hiking; one base in Rotorua or Taupō, easier with a car.
tradeoffs: The Crossing is crowded on fine summer days
Rotorua smells of sulphur
Mountain weather cancels the Crossing often

picks.name: Palawan: El Nido & Coron
picks.why: Beaches and swimming and coastal scenery; split between El Nido and Coron, no car needed.
tradeoffs: Takes several connections to reach.
Popular lagoons get crowded at midday
Ferry crossings can be rough

text: Two weeks of trekking in July, anywhere in the world, moderate budget.

discovery.request: Two weeks of trekking in July, anywhere in the world, moderate budget.

drivers: What you want to do: mountains and trekking and hiking
readout.spread: Three different answers — Cordillera Blanca for high mountains and multi-day trekking; West MacDonnell Ranges for multi-day trekking and day hiking; Madeira for day hiking and high mountains.

picks.name: Cordillera Blanca
picks.why: Day hiking and multi-day trekking; strong on mountains and trekking and hiking.
tradeoffs: Takes several connections to reach.
Everything starts above 3,000 m
Facilities are basic outside Huaraz

picks.name: West MacDonnell Ranges
picks.why: Multi-day trekking and day hiking; strong on mountains and trekking and hiking.
tradeoffs: Takes several connections to reach.
Too hot to trek from November to March
Water on the Larapinta must be planned section by section

picks.name: Madeira
picks.why: Day hiking and coastal scenery; strong on mountains and trekking and hiking.

length.note: Best for 4–12 nights. With 14, consider pairing it with another region.

tradeoffs: Few sandy beaches
Popular levadas are busy
Mountains are often in cloud

readout.spread: Three different answers — Bernese Oberland for high mountains and lakes; Krabi & the Andaman Coast for coastal scenery and beaches and swimming; Oaxaca City & Valleys for city life and villages and culture.

picks.name: Bernese Oberland
picks.why: Easy for a family, day hiking and high mountains; one base in Grindelwald or Wengen, no car needed.
tradeoffs: Very expensive, especially the high railways
Crowded viewpoints in summer
Lifts close for maintenance in April–May and November

picks.name: Krabi & the Andaman Coast
picks.why: Easy for a family and coastal scenery; one base in Railay or Ao Nang, no car needed.
tradeoffs: Phi Phi and Railay are very busy
Rainy season makes seas rough and services thin
Ao Nang is heavily developed

picks.name: Oaxaca City & Valleys
picks.why: Food and villages and culture; strong on beautiful scenery and easy family time.
tradeoffs: Day of the Dead week is crowded and expensive
Rainy-season afternoons from June to September
The city is at 1,550 m and nights can be cool

text: Warm beaches and snorkelling over Christmas, from London, with the kids.

discovery.request: Warm beaches and snorkelling over Christmas, from London, with the kids.

drivers: What you want to do: beaches and coast
readout.spread: Three different answers — Turks & Caicos for snorkelling and diving and beaches and swimming; Zanzibar for beaches and swimming and snorkelling and diving; Krabi & the Andaman Coast for coastal scenery and beaches and swimming.

picks.name: Turks & Caicos
picks.why: Easy with children; one base in Providenciales or Grand Turk, easier with a car.
tradeoffs: Very expensive
Flat, scrubby islands with little hiking or culture
Eating out costs resort prices

picks.name: Zanzibar
picks.why: Easy with children; one base in Stone Town or Nungwi, no car needed.
tradeoffs: East-coast tides retreat a long way, limiting swimming at low tide
The northern beaches are heavily developed

picks.name: Krabi & the Andaman Coast
picks.why: Easy with children; one base in Railay or Ao Nang, no car needed.
tradeoffs: Phi Phi and Railay are very busy
Rainy season makes seas rough and services thin
Ao Nang is heavily developed

discovery.request: Ten days in October, culture and food, I love walking cities.

drivers: What you want to do: culture and food and cities, culture and food first
readout.spread: Three different answers — Kyoto & Nara for villages and culture and food; Québec City & Charlevoix for villages and culture and food; Tuscany for villages and culture and food.

picks.name: Kyoto & Nara
picks.why: Villages and culture and food; strong on culture and food and cities.
tradeoffs: Very crowded in cherry-blossom and maple seasons
Hot and humid summers
Rooms are expensive at peak

picks.name: Québec City & Charlevoix
picks.why: Villages and culture and food; strong on culture and food and cities.
tradeoffs: Winter cold snaps reach −25 °C
The Old Town is hilly with many stairs
Summer and Carnival lodging is pricey

picks.name: Tuscany
picks.why: Villages and culture and food; strong on culture and food and cities.
tradeoffs: Florence is crowded most of the year
July and August are very hot
